description: This file contains the core game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game, including data structures to represent game state, functions to make moves, detect winners, and check for draws. It defines the GameState data class and the GameEngine object with its associated methods and constants.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: An immutable data class capturing the current snapshot of the game board, current player, game over status, and optional winner.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Processes a move at a given index; updates the game state accordingly, checking for a winner or draw.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Determines if there's a winner given the current board configuration.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw based on the current board.
